ITEM TITLE:
..Title
Forma Construction JOC project #JC-24-29-F JCP Piping and Pump

..body
DEPARTMENT:  Facilities and Fleet

ORIGINATOR:  Alex Pidduck 

EXECUTIVE RECOMMENDATION:  Approved

PURPOSE: Requesting signature to move forward with the Piping and Pump project for the Oakes Jail Central heating and cooling systems utilizing Forma Construction through Job Order Contracting (JOC) RFP-22-015DW Agreement; award approved through Snohomish County Council Motion 22-266.   

BACKGROUND: This project is a result of the 2023 Energy Audit recommendations and is needed reduce energy consumption to meet the Clean Buildings Act energy target.  This project accounts for an estimated 9.2 EUI points toward the 16.3 that are needed to reach the target.  This project will reconfigure the heating water piping loop, replace boiler circulation pumps, install variable frequency drives on the condenser water pumps, install a new pump to enable the "free-heating" heat exchanger to work properly, and upgrade the building automation controller for the Central Plant.  Approximately $315,000 of this work will be reimbursed in the future via the Washington State Department of Commerce Early Adopter Incentive funding, provided our target is met after a 12-month verification period.  This project is supplemental to other energy use reduction work, which is in progress.  The cost for this project is $364,493.40 plus applicable tax.  A detailed scope of work is found in attached proposal JC-24-29-F.

ITEM TITLE:
..title
Proprietary (Single Source) Purchase - Rescue Hoist for Second Sheriff's Office Rescue Helicopter
..body

DEPARTMENT:  Sheriff's Office

ORIGINATOR:  Lynda Thomas

EXECUTIVE RECOMMENDATION:  Approved

PURPOSE: Single Source Purchase of rescue hoist for installation on 2nd Sheriff's Office rescue helicopter

BACKGROUND: This rescue hoist will be installed on the second Sheriff's Office rescue helicopter.  The hoist will be used during rescue operations in the mountains to insert rescuers, then extract both rescuers and an injured patient.  This equipment is critical in conducting rescue operations in the Cascade Mountains where ground transport is not feasible since no roads exist in most of the back country.  The permanently installed rescue hoist mounting system and wiring system is the same system on both rescue helicopters.  This allows for either hoist to be mounted on either helicopter.  Pendant hoist controls are the same and can be used interchangeably.  Hoist cables are also the same part number and can be mounted on either hoist.  On Board Systems Hoist and Winch was formerly known as Collins Aerospace which operated Goodrich Hoist Company.  The same manufacturing facility is now operated by On Board Systems, so all the parts and construction are identical to our previous hoist.  Our current hoist is mounted on the primary rescue helicopter "SnoHawk 10" and is the same make and model as the rescue hoist being purchased.  It is important to have both of these hoists compatible since they both use the same hoist cable which needs to be periodically changed, and the same hoist pendant control which will also be interchangeable.  There is only one other company that manufactures rescue hoists and their cable and pendant are not compatible with the existing hoist.

ITEM TITLE:
..Title
Motion 25-572, approving the 2025-2027 agreement between Snohomish County and Lexipol, LLC for a Sole Source Agreement for subscription material related to policy and procedure manuals
..body
DEPARTMENT:  Sheriff's Office

ORIGINATOR:  Dawn Cicero

EXECUTIVE RECOMMENDATION:  Approved by Ken Klein 12/8/25

PURPOSE: Authorize the approval of an agreement with Lexipol, LLC

BACKGROUND: The Sheriff's Office maintains two policy and procedure manuals-one for the law enforcement bureau and one for the corrections bureau-each containing 30 chapters, along with general orders and standard operating procedures. LEXIPOL, LLC continually researches laws and court cases to support ongoing updates to these manuals. In accordance with SCC 3.04.180 (11), the program and services provided are limited to a single source of supply through Lexipol, LLC, the sole authorized distributor in the United States. Sole Source SS-24-001JM was processed and posted by the Purchasing Division. The Purchasing Division approved Lexipol as a sole source provider. The Sheriff's Office is requesting a three-year contract to subscribe to this service agreement.
